role: Second half of WorkoutLiveCoachingNamespace: LLM fact/action entries for journey intelligence, OSM roads-ahead, detailed current location, forward-geocode override, MapKit directions (routeTo/next_step/clear), user thresholds, interval-plan progress and post-stop HRR capture status.
types: WorkoutLiveCoachingNamespace: extension (struct declared in AppFactResolver+LiveCoaching.swift) — navigation/threshold/interval/HRR fact entries
AddressLookup: enum (private, Sendable) — matched(RoadContext) | unmatched, the forward-geocode outcome; nil from the timeout race means no answer in time
state: static let journeyDescription — model-facing description for location.journey (says it runs on the active Get Me Back trail; a workout alone does not record one)
static let directionsRouteToDescription / directionsRouteToDestinationDescription — model-facing descriptions for directions.routeTo and its destination parameter
toplevel: Private static lets medicalPOIQuery, journeyDescription, directionsRouteToDescription and directionsRouteToDestinationDescription (model-facing text for directions.routeTo and its destination parameter), private enums DestinationResolution and AddressLookup. directions.* and location.journey are not behind the workout-only location gate: the cloud consent sheet discloses the position used when the user asks for directions and the Get Me Back trail while it runs (comment above directionsRouteToEntry).

units.does: Returns the 14 navigation FactEntries (journey, roads_ahead, current_detailed, set_address, directions routeTo/next_step/clear, thresholds active/any_breaching/breach_state, interval active/current_step/next_step, hrr_capture_status) appended to coachingEntries by WorkoutLiveCoachingNamespace.entries.

no cached GPS fix ≤60 s old
branches.effect: returns .missing notRecorded 'no fresh GPS fix'; otherwise continues

branches.cond: roadAwareness returned nil (no tile or 3 s timeout)
result safe to quote (conf ≥0.4 and phrase) OR neighbourhood-only

flags.text: docs/USERS_MANUAL.md says that when confidence is below 0.4 or the phrase is null the AI must say 'I don't have road data for this stretch', but line 71 also returns a record for a neighbourhood-only result at confidence 0 (phrase 'walking through <subdivision>'), so the manual's contract is out of date.

units.does: Trims the 'address' arg and forward-geocodes it (12 s cap, room for a queued forward geocode); a match overrides RoadGeocodingService's current context (and AmbientLocationService's address mirror) and returns the resolved address record; no match or an unreachable geocoder returns invalidParameter; no answer in time returns notRecorded telling the model to retry rather than ask the user to rephrase. Not gated on an active workout.

branches.cond: address arg missing or blank after trim

units.does: Runs RoadGeocodingService.geocodeAddress(query) in a 12 s FactResolveTimeout race (the queued forward geocode can wait for an in-flight geocoder call (≤5 s), then the 1 s rate floor, then make its own ≤5 s call; forward geocodes skip the failure backoff) and wraps the result as AddressLookup.matched/unmatched; nil means the race timed out.
Maps a RoadContext to status/road/locality/admin area/country/country_code/compact_address/lat/lon record.

units.does: Lowercases/trims the destination key, resolves it to a DirectionsService.Destination, computes a medical safety notice for hospital destinations, gets a user fix (cache ≤60 s, else cold GPS ≤7 s), computes the MapKit route (4 s cap; the lookup task is cancelled when the budget runs out; DirectionsService engages ActiveRouteSession on success) and returns the route record or failure, with the safety notice attached either way. No workout gate: the consent sheet discloses the position used for directions.

branches.effect: returns that FactValue (unknown key / missing address / no home)

branches.cond: no user location (cache miss and cold fix failed/timed out)
branches.effect: returns notRecorded 'couldn't get a current location fix' with safety notice prepended; otherwise computes and returns route outcome with notice

flags.text: On the 4 s timeout computeRoute now cancels the lookup task, but DirectionsService.resolveRoute engages ActiveRouteSession after MapKit answers without checking cancellation, so a route the model reported as timed out can still engage later and drive directions.next_step and turn alerts. Needs a Task.checkCancellation() before engage in DirectionsService (handoff).

units.does: For destination .poi('hospital') returns the model instruction to say first that an injured/unwell user should call the local emergency number(s); nil for every other destination.

returns .missing with detail = notice + ' ' + original detail (nil detail dropped)
